basics.description: **Sentinel Accelerated All-In-One** deployment, see more information about this project [here](https://github.com/wissamyanis/sentinel-all-in-one-defender).

options.text: This template deploys at the subscription scope: it creates the resource group and all resources inside it. You need Owner or Contributor on the selected subscription. If you see a red permission message above, click here to learn more.

basics.name: subscriptionId
basics.label: Select a subscription:
basics.toolTip: Select a subscription where Sentinel All-in-One will be deployed.

constraints.validationMessage: Only alphanumeric characters are allowed, and the value must be 1-30 characters long.

basics.name: workspaceName
basics.label: Workspace Name
basics.toolTip: The Workspace name should include 4-63 letters, digits or '-'. The '-' shouldn't be the first or the last symbol.

constraints.validationMessage: Only alphanumeric characters are allowed, and the value must be 1-30 characters long.

basics.name: dailyQuota
basics.label: Daily ingestion limit in GBs. Enter 0 for no limit.
basics.toolTip: This limit doesn't apply to the following tables: SecurityAlert, SecurityBaseline, SecurityBaselineSummary, SecurityDetection, SecurityEvent, WindowsFirewall, MaliciousIPCommunication, LinuxAuditLog, SysmonEvent, ProtectionStatus, WindowsEvent. [Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/logs/daily-cap)

constraints.validationMessage: Only numbers allowed, and the value must be 1-4 characters long.
Retention must be between 30 and 730 days.

basics.name: pricingTier
basics.label: Select pricing tier
basics.toolTip: Simplified pricing tier covering both Log Analytics ingestion and Microsoft Sentinel analysis. Visit the [Microsoft Sentinel Pricing page](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/microsoft-sentinel) for more information.

basics.name: capacityReservation
basics.label: Select Commitment Tier (GB/day)
basics.toolTip: Select the Commitment Tier in GB/day. The 50 GB/day tier is available in the simplified (unified) pricing model.

options.text: Please select which settings you would like to enable in your Microsoft Sentinel environment

elements.name: enableUeba
elements.label: Enable User Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA)? Global Admin or Security Admin permission required.
elements.toolTip: This will only enable synchronization with identity providers. Data sources need to be enabled separately. [Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/identify-threats-with-entity-behavior-analytics)

elements.name: identityProviders
elements.label: Select which Identity Providers will be synchronized with UEBA
elements.toolTip: Microsoft Entra ID works on any tenant. On-prem Active Directory only syncs if Microsoft Defender for Identity (MDI) is connected - selecting it without MDI has no effect.

allowedValues.label: On-prem Active Directory (only works if Microsoft Defender for Identity is connected)

elements.name: enableDiagnostics
elements.label: Enable Sentinel health diagnostics?
elements.toolTip: This will enable diagnostics settings for Analytics rules, Data Connectors and Automation rules. [Learn more](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/sentinel/health-audit)

options.text: Please select which Solutions you want to install into your Microsoft Sentinel environment. Solutions may contain different content types, like data connectors, analytics rules, parsers, workbooks, playbooks, hunting queries, etc.

elements.name: enableSolutions
elements.label: Select Content Hub solutions to install
elements.toolTip: Select the solutions that you would like to install

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Entra ID
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Entra ID solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest Microsoft Entra ID Audit, Sign-in, Provisioning, Risk Events and Risky User/Service Principal logs using Diagnostic Settings into Microsoft Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Azure Activity
allowedValues.description: The Azure Activity solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest Azure Activity Administrative, Security, Service Health, Alert, Recommendation, Policy, Autoscale and Resource Health logs using Diagnostic Settings into Microsoft Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Cloud Identity Threat Protection Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Cloud Identity Threat Protection Essentials solution looks for most common cloud focused identity attacks such as Suspicious Sign-ins, privilege grants, MFA disable etc.

allowedValues.label: Endpoint Threat Protection Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Endpoint Threat Protection Essentials solution provides content to monitor, detect and investigate threats related to windows machines.

allowedValues.label: Dynamics 365 CE
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Sentinel solution for Dynamics 365 CE apps provides threat monitoring, detection and incident response capabilities for Dynamics 365 CE apps.

allowedValues.label: Apache Log4j Vulnerability Detection
allowedValues.description: This solution provides content to monitor, detect and investigate signals related to exploitation of a remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in Apache Log4j 2 thru Microsoft Sentinel.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft 365
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft 365 solution for Microsoft Sentinel enables you to ingest operational logs from Microsoft 365 to gain insights into user and admin activity across your collaboration platforms such as Teams, SharePoint and Exchange.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Defender for Cloud solution for Microsoft Sentinel allows you to ingest Security alerts reported in Microsoft Defender for Cloud on assessing your hybrid cloud workload's security posture.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
allowedValues.description: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint is an enterprise endpoint security platform designed to help enterprise networks prevent, detect, investigate, and respond to advanced threats.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for IoT
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Defender for IoT solution for Microsoft Sentinel allows you to ingest Security alerts reported in Microsoft Defender for IoT on assessing your Internet of Things (IoT)/Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management
allowedValues.description: This solution enables insider risk management teams to investigate risk-based behavior across 25+ Microsoft products. This solution is a better-together story between Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Purview Information Protection
allowedValues.description: Ingests sensitivity-label auditing events from Microsoft Purview Information Protection (unified labeling clients and scanners) into Microsoft Sentinel for data-security monitoring.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Power BI
allowedValues.description: The Microsoft Power BI solution enables you to track user activities in your Power BI environment.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Project
allowedValues.description: Stream your Microsoft Project audit logs into Microsoft Sentinel in order to track your project activities.

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Teams
allowedValues.description: Microsoft Sentinel for Teams provides Teams security logs visibility and threat protection.

allowedValues.label: Security Threat Essentials
allowedValues.description: This solution published by Microsoft is based on the continuous evaluation of threat campaigns and provides out-of-the-box security content that helps you to enhance your security posture.

allowedValues.label: SOAR Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Sentinel SOAR Essentials solution for Microsoft Sentinel contains Playbooks that can help you get started with basic notification and orchestration scenarios for common use cases.

allowedValues.label: Threat Intelligence
allowedValues.description: Ingest threat indicators into Microsoft Sentinel. Threat indicators can be IP addresses, domains, URLs and file hashes and can be used to correlate across log sources for known indicators of compromise and/or indicators of active attack

allowedValues.label: UEBA Essentials
allowedValues.description: The Sentinel UEBA content package will provide you with various queries based on UEBA tables, that allows you to hunt for tailored threat scenarios.

options.text: Select the Data Connectors to enable. The Microsoft Defender connectors (Defender XDR, Endpoint, Identity, Cloud Apps, Office 365 ATP) are intentionally not listed here: on workspaces onboarded to the Defender portal they are enabled and managed automatically by Defender. Only pick additional connectors your tenant is licensed and consented for - a connector that fails will fail the whole deployment.

elements.name: enableDataConnectors
elements.label: Select data connectors to onboard
elements.toolTip: Select the data connectors that you would like to enable

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Entra ID (sign-in & audit logs)
allowedValues.description: Streams Entra ID SignInLogs and AuditLogs to the workspace via tenant diagnostic settings (this is separate from the Sentinel Entra ID connector, which the Defender portal manages on onboarded workspaces). Enables the identity analytics rules. Requires Global Administrator and an Entra ID P1/P2 license for sign-in logs.

allowedValues.label: Azure Activity
allowedValues.description: This will only bring logs from the subscription selected in Basics tab. Relevant permissions at the subscription level are required.

allowedValues.label: Dynamics 365
allowedValues.description: Relevant license and Global Admin or Security Admin permission required

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
allowedValues.description: Security Reader permission required

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management
allowedValues.description: Relevant license and Global Admin or Security Admin permission required

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Power BI
allowedValues.description: Relevant license and Global Admin or Security Admin permission required

allowedValues.label: Microsoft Project
allowedValues.description: Relevant license and Global Admin or Security Admin permission required

allowedValues.label: Office 365
allowedValues.description: Relevant license and Global Admin or Security Admin permission required

allowedValues.label: Security Events via AMA (Windows)
allowedValues.description: Deploys a Data Collection Rule to collect Windows Security events via the Azure Monitor Agent. You still need to associate the DCR with your machines (AMA must be installed).

allowedValues.label: Common Event Format (CEF) via AMA
allowedValues.description: Deploys a Data Collection Rule to collect CEF messages (firewalls and security appliances, e.g. Palo Alto) via a Linux log forwarder running the Azure Monitor Agent. You must deploy and associate the forwarder VM separately.

allowedValues.label: Syslog via AMA (Linux)
allowedValues.description: Deploys a Data Collection Rule to collect Linux Syslog messages via the Azure Monitor Agent. You must install and associate AMA on the source/forwarder machines separately.

elements.name: securityEventSet
elements.label: Windows Security event set (AMA)
elements.toolTip: Choose which set of Windows Security events the Data Collection Rule collects.

elements.name: aadStreams
elements.label: Microsoft Entra ID log types to stream
elements.toolTip: Select which Microsoft Entra ID diagnostic log categories to stream to the workspace.

options.text: Please select which analytics rules you would like to enable in your Microsoft Sentinel environment

elements.name: enableMLAlerts
elements.label: Enable ML Behavior Analytics alert rules?
elements.toolTip: Select to enable ML Behavior Analytics rules for selected connectors (SecurityEvents and/or Syslog)

constraints.validationMessage: Enables SSH and/or RDP anomalous login alerts

elements.name: enableScheduledAlerts
elements.label: Enable a curated set of built-in analytics rules (recommended)
elements.toolTip: Deploys a curated set of Microsoft incident-creation rules (for the selected Microsoft connectors) plus scheduled KQL detections for Entra ID sign-in/audit activity. These are native ARM rules - no deployment script. Leave unchecked to deploy no analytics rules.

constraints.validationMessage: Deploys the curated analytics rule set

elements.name: severityLevels
elements.label: Analytics rule severities to enable
elements.toolTip: Choose which severities of the built-in scheduled (KQL) analytics rules to deploy. A scheduled rule is only created when its severity is selected here. Microsoft incident-creation rules inherit the source alert's severity and are not affected.
